slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers per truck, despite U6 stating each truck can carry up to 2 containers.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Truck capacity is irrelevant or unlimited; the model omits any constraint that each truck can carry up to 2 containers.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about truck capacity, and the READY_TO_MODEL summary lists only warehouse inventory and port demand as limits, effectively assuming no truck capacity constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only unresolved hidden slot is P2 truck capacity, which does not affect the core transportation cost model or feasibility. The agent resolved all P0/P1-relevant modeling facts before READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent thoroughly clarified the transportation model, including supply/demand handling, cost structure, integrality, route availability, and leftover containers. It missed the low-impact P2 truck capacity detail, but this does not materially affect the optimization model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
